path_decision.reason: No canonical growth-foundry or claim-graph module exists. The implementation paths are isolated from web routes and preserve Mission 2 as the sole lifecycle and authority foundation. Existing durability and workflow policy surfaces require a narrow exact-path extension so the new files are owned and the M001 court is mandatory; the canonical handoff includes those supporting paths explicitly.
